soundscape: Muffled bus interior hum, soft rain patter on glass, and a low engine drone.

claims.text: Rain runs down a bus window at night while the city slides past outside.
Atmospheric details include amber and red city lights, condensation, a dark seat edge and ceiling shadow, and faint reflections in the glass.

description.text: A rain-streaked bus window fills the vertical frame at night. Droplets bead across the glass in irregular clusters, some round and heavy, others stretched into trembling ovals. Beyond the pane, the city is out of focus: amber streetlights, red tail-lights, and cool neon bloom into soft smeared bokeh. A faint reflection of the dark bus interior ghosts across the lower corner of the glass. The scene is quiet and close, all texture and muted color, as the first droplets gather enough weight to begin their slow descent.
Rain beads tremble on the glass; beyond it, streetlights and neon blur into soft smeared bokeh.
Muffled bus interior hum under a soft patter of rain.
Small droplets merge and begin to slide, leaving thin wet trails.

At this closer scale, condensation fogs the glass in a pale veil. One rivulet cuts a wavering path downward, clearing a thin, glossy channel that catches pinpricks of amber and cyan from outside. Smaller droplets cling at its edges, quivering before they join the flow. Through the rain-smeared pane, streaks of streetlight and signage slide laterally, stretched into long soft bands by the glass and the bus’s motion. The surface feels cold, slick, and alive with tiny movements.
Rain patter continues; a low engine drone vibrates through the glass.
Condensation clouds the pane around a single rivulet, its edges catching amber and cyan reflections.
The rivulet wavers downward; outside, light streaks drift sideways as the bus moves.

The window comes back into context within the dim bus interior. A dark seat edge and the shadowed curve of the ceiling frame the lower and side edges of the glass, while the night city continues to sweep past beyond it. Sheets of rain blur the outside into moving color: warm lamps, red signals, and pale shop signs dragged into horizontal glows. Inside, condensation thickens near the frame, and several rivulets run in parallel, catching faint reflections. The atmosphere is hushed, enclosed, and steadily in motion.
Steady rain on glass and faint interior hum fill the quiet.
The window sits within the dim bus interior; dark seat edge and ceiling shadow frame the lower corners.
More rivulets join and run; city glow sweeps across the pane in longer, faster streaks.
